Overview

Turing is hiring Physics Research Scientists (PhD, Remote) to test and improve how advanced AI models handle reasoning and problem-solving in physics. Work with top AI labs, contribute to frontier benchmarks, and earn upto $150 / hr on a flexible, remote schedule.

Role Overview :

We are seeking PhD-level Physics researchers to rigorously test the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). In this role, you’ll create physics problems, analyze model responses, and identify logical gaps to help improve AI’s conceptual understanding and structured problem-solving.

This is a remote, contract-based role with flexible weekly hour options (10, 20, or 30).

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and evaluate challenging physics problems to test AI reasoning.
  • Analyze AI-generated solutions for logic, rigor, and step-by-step clarity.
  • Provide detailed, constructive feedback that highlights gaps in reasoning.
  • Contribute to the development of benchmarks that measure model performance on abstract and multi-step tasks.
  • Collaborate with researchers to refine methodologies for testing AI reasoning.

Must-have Qualifications

  • PhD or Postdoctoral (or currently enrolled) in Physics, Applied Physics, or related fields.
  • Strong ability to solve complex, multi-step problems with structured reasoning.
  • Skilled communicator, able to explain logic and critique clearly in writing.
  • Independent, self-motivated, and comfortable in a remote setting.
  • Reliable computer and internet setup.

Why Join Turing?

  • Impact : Help define how AI models reason about abstract, scientific problems.
  • Prestige : Work with leading AI labs shaping the future of reasoning systems.
  • Flexibility : Remote-first, with weekly hour options.
  • Career Growth : Gain experience at the intersection of AI and physics research.

Contract & Selection Process :

  • Compensation : $50–$150 per hour, based on skills and experience. (paid once every two weeks).
  • Duration : 1 week to 3 months (project-based; extension possible).
  • Hours : Up to 30 hrs / week.
  • Time Zone : 2–5 hrs / day overlap with UTC-8 (America / Los_Angeles), confirmed near onboarding.

About Turing

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, partnering with leading AI research labs to advance frontier model capabilities in reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, and STEM. Our work directly shapes how next-generation AI systems solve mission-critical challenges across science, technology, and industry.

description:
Application Instructions

Please send your CV to before September 19th, 2025.

IMPORTANT: Applications submitted through LinkedIn will not be considered. Only emailed applications will be reviewed.

About Us

Eulen.app, the company behind DePix (a privacy-centric stablecoin), builds products for the sovereign individual with a focus on security, privacy, and technical excellence. We are looking for a battle-tested, hands-on architect to become the guardian of our core production systems.

The Role

This is a deeply technical, hands-on position for a master craftsperson who prefers architecting and shipping brilliant code to attending meetings. As the technical owner of our high-volume core services, you will be the gatekeeper of quality, the champion of reliability, and the calm voice of reason during a crisis. Your mission: to ensure our systems run with unwavering stability and speed, enabling us to deploy frequently and safely.

Required Qualifications

  • 15+ years of working experience in critical, high-volume environments
  • Strong knowledge of backend programming (Rust, Go, C++, or similar)
  • Expertise in scalable and resilient architecture
  • Proven experience with automated testing and incident response
  • Background in designing and operating mission-critical systems
  • Excellent problem-solving and collaboration skills
  • Self-motivated, lifetime learner, aligned with Bitcoin ethos

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Bitcoin protocols (Liquid, Lightning)
  • Familiarity with compliance-aware architecture in fintech
  • Open-source contributions
  • Background in cryptography or financial systems
  • Previous startup or scale-up experience

Hiring Process

  1. September 19th (Friday): Phase 0 begins. Instructions are sent at 00:00 BRT. This first challenge (via Google Forms) must be completed within 24 hours.
  2. September 20th (Saturday): Candidates who successfully pass Phase 0 will receive instructions for Phase 1. This next stage, consisting of cultural and logical assessments, must be completed on this day.
  3. September 21st (Sunday): Successful candidates from the previous stage will receive instructions for Phase 2. This final challenge, a specific technical deep-dive, must be completed on this day.
  4. Candidates who successfully complete all phases will be contacted to schedule a final interview, which may be conducted online or in person.

Join us to architect the backbone of Bitcoin payments, ensuring security, reliability, and technical excellence in a remote-first, high-performance culture.

At Turner & Townsend we’re passionate about making the difference. That means delivering better outcomes for our clients, helping our people to realize their potential, and doing our part to create a prosperous society.

Responsibilities

Interfacing with the client and other consultants, at all project stages. Responsible of manage overall project cost, schedule and budgets as well as manage general contractor and other directly contracted vendors and consultants.

  • Fluência em inglês;

  • Experiência com configuração de pontos finais e monitoramento SOAMANAGER, ou SAP PI/PO, ou SAP CPI;
  • Experiência avançada em SQL;
  • Graduação/mestrado em Ciência da Computação ou Engenharia.

Outras qualificações preferenciais incluem:

  • Experiência em negócios de comércio global ou cadeia de suprimentos, impostos indiretos, conformidade e/ou processos de declaração de impostos;

  • Experiência na criação e execução de casos de teste e scripts de teste.

  • Benefícios Competitivos: planos de saúde, odontológicos, dois dias de feriado corporativo para saúde mental, programas de incentivo por performance e recursos de bem-estar.

  • Impacto Social: oportunidades de voluntariado pagos e consultoria pro bono/ESG.
  • Fazendo um Impacto Real no Mundo: atuação para apoiar justiça, verdade e transparência, com profissionais e instituições parceiros.

    • Proven experience with one or more topics listed above.

We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, prior experience coding with Python, Kotlin, or Golang, working with message queues & async processing are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

We\'re a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

Access onsite gyms and fitness studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, and more. You will receive the Gold plan at no cost, and other premium plans will be significantly discounted.

As a Flexible First company, we offer two work model options: flexible hybrid and full remote, and make the office a place for collaboration, community, and team building. The model for this role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a home office stipend and a monthly flexible work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.
  • FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Wellhubbers and their leaders can make the best decisions for their scope. This includes flexibility to adjust their working hours based on their personal schedule, time zone, and business needs.
  • PAID TIME OFF: Vacations after 6 months and 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + extra day off for your birthday.
  • PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: 100% paid parental leave to all new parents and extended maternity leave.
  • CAREER GROWTH: Outstanding opportunities for personal and career growth. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do and invest deeply in employee development.
  • CULTURE: An exciting and supportive atmosphere with ambitious people from around the world! You’ll partner with global colleagues and share in the success of a high-growth technology company disrupting the health and wellness space. Our value-based culture of trust, flexibility, and integrity makes this possible everyday. Find more info on our careers page.

And to get a glimpse of life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram and LinkedIn.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Snaps are next-generation software packaging and delivery for Linux, designed for safety, security and robustness, with application-specific confinement of containers optimised for IoT devices, desktops and servers. Our goal is that snaps work across multiple Linux flavors to ensure that publishers have the simplest way to reach the whole Linux world.

This role requires an obsession with quality and performance, for work at the heart of the operating system. It also requires an interest in the software publishing and consumption experience. Applicants should be passionate about open source software development. We value collaboration, peer reviews, good unit/integration testing and maintainable code. Python and Kubernetes Software Engineer - Data, AI/ML & Analytics

Join to apply for the Python and Kubernetes Software Engineer - Data, AI/ML & Analytics role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring Python and Kubernetes Specialist Engineers focused on Data, AI/ML and Analytics Solutions to join our teams building open source solutions for public cloud and private infrastructure.
As a software engineer on the team, you'll collaborate on an end-to-end data analytics and mlops solution composed of popular, open-source, machine learning tools, such as Kubeflow, MLFlow, DVC, and Feast. You may also work on workflow, ETL, data governance and visualization tools like Apache SuperSet, dbt, and Temporal, or data warehouse solutions such as Apache Trino, or ClickHouse. Your team will own a solution from the analytics and machine learning space, and integrate with the solutions from other teams to build the world's best end-to-end data platform. These solutions may be run on servers or on the cloud, on machines or on Kubernetes, on developer desktops, or as web services.
We serve the needs of individuals and community members as much as the needs of our Global 2000 and Fortune 500 customers; we make our primary work available free of charge and our Pro subscriptions are also available to individuals for personal use at no cost. Our goal is to enable more people to enjoy the benefits of open source, regardless of their circumstances.
Location: This initiative spans many teams that are home-based and in multiple time zones. We believe in distributed collaboration but we also try to ensure that colleagues have company during their work hourse! Successful candidates will join a team where most members and your manager are broadly in the same time zone so that you have the benefits of constant collaboration and discussion.
What your day will look like

  • Develop your understanding of the entire Linux stack, from kernel, networking, and storage, to the application layer
  • Design, build and maintain solutions that will be deployed on public and private clouds and local workstations
  • Master distributed systems concepts such as observability, identity, tracing
  • Work with both Kubernetes and machine-oriented open source applications
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team of engineers, designers and product managers
  • Debug issues and interact in public with upstream and Ubuntu communities
  • Generate and discuss ideas, and collaborate on finding good solutions
What we are looking for in you
  • Professional or academic software delivery using Python
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organisation
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Additional Skills That Would Be Nice To Have

The following skills may be helpful to you in the role, but we don't expect everyone to bring all of them.
  • Hands-on experience with machine learning libraries, or tools.
  • Proven track record of building highly automated machine learning solutions for the cloud.
  • Experience with container technologies (Docker, LXD, Kubernetes, etc.)
  • Experience with public clouds (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
  • Working knowledge of cloud computing
  • Passionate about software quality and testing
  • Experience working on an open source project
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Overview

Sequencing.com is on a mission to make advanced whole genome sequencing accessible and actionable for everyone. We’re a startup at the intersection of SaaS, eCommerce, and health tech - offering DNA testing kits, secure DNA data storage, and a growing marketplace of reports and proprietary AI tools that help people understand their genetic data. We’re looking for a customer-obsessed, data-savvy, and outcome-oriented Product Manager to bring structure to our roadmap and help us scale with purpose. This is a senior individual contributor role with high visibility and strategic impact. You’ll be responsible for managing high-impact product initiatives across the platform, driving execution from discovery through delivery. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a high-ownership environment, demands excellence in execution, and leads with clarity and decisiveness. You must have a builder’s mentality and a proven track record of releasing successful consumer-facing products.

What You’ll Do

  • Own and Drive the Product Roadmap: Maintain and enforce a focused product roadmap across our core platform, ensuring clarity of scope, priority, and impact. Track all features, bugs, and enhancements across Engineering, Design, Bioinformatics, and Customer Success.
  • Lead Discovery & Customer Insight Work: Combine qualitative and quantitative approaches to deeply understand our customers. Actively engage with users through interviews, testing, and platform usage, while also analyzing product and behavioral data to uncover patterns, friction points, and opportunities. Use both first-hand insights and data-driven findings to anchor product direction in real customer needs and outcomes.
  • Define & Scope Features: Translate customer insights and company goals into actionable product plans with clear documentation, timelines, and success criteria. Ensure projects are aligned with what moves the needle.
  • Execution Leadership: Collaborate cross-functionally to scope, de-risk, and deliver high-quality features at startup speed. Push teams toward urgency and disciplined execution.
  • Documentation Ownership: Write and maintain detailed product specs, user flows, success metrics, and timelines in Confluence and Jira. Your documentation will be the single source of truth.
  • Jira & Process Stewardship: Own the ROAD Jira board, ensuring tickets are properly structured, linked, and prioritized. Proactively manage dependencies, identify blockers, and support delivery cadence.
  • Product Communication & Strategic Thinking: Be a direct, clear communicator who can articulate priorities and say ‘no’ when needed. Protect the product from scope creep, stakeholder appeasement, or feel-good but low-impact projects.
  • Align, but Don’t Please: Collaborate effectively with stakeholders while prioritizing product quality and outcomes over consensus or politics. Communicate hard decisions without soft-pedaling.
  • Contribute to Product Culture: Raise the bar for quality, execution, and decision-making in a fast-paced startup environment. Help instill clarity, urgency, and discipline in the way we build.

What We’re Looking For

  • Customer-obsessed: You always start with the user and are proactive about talking to them. You’ve used our platform - or would have - before applying.
  • 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in SaaS, consumer subscription, or health tech.
  • Highly data-driven: You can track and act on business and user metrics and apply analytical rigor to prioritize effectively.
  • Proven track record of shipping and scaling consumer products, particularly subscription-based platforms.
  • Strategic mindset: You can connect high-level goals with actionable plans, and keep long-term vision front and center.
  • Mission-driven: You’re excited by the potential of genomics and motivated by real impact.
  • Exacting standards: You push for excellence and aren’t afraid to raise the bar.
  • Resilient to pushback: You don’t fold under pressure and remain firm when decisions are right.
  • Direct communicator: You value clarity over ambiguity and fairness over comfort.
  • Executional excellence: You have the organizational skills to juggle multiple initiatives while delivering results.
  • Builder’s mentality: You earn respect through work product, not charm, and lead through doing.
  • Respect without people-pleasing: You collaborate well but don’t need universal approval to drive results.

About Sequencing

Sequencing is powering the future of personalized health. We are the platform that transforms a person’s genome into a lifelong source of straightforward, actionable insights - for individuals, families, and healthcare professionals. By providing the application layer to your DNA, we turn complex genetic data into recurring value throughout every stage of life.

Our unique, clinical-grade Whole Genome Sequencing unlocks the most complete view of your DNA, screening for almost all known health conditions, traits, and medication responses - and translating that information into clear, actionable steps for managing health risks, optimizing wellness, and extending longevity.

As whole genome sequencing becomes a standard part of life, Sequencing is already the trusted platform where people safely store their DNA data - and will become the lifelong home for every genome on Earth.

We’re a fully remote, global team of innovators, scientists, and builders, united by a mission to make genomics accessible, actionable, and life-changing for everyone.

Proudly named GenomeWeb’s Best Place to Work in 2024, Sequencing is venture-backed and scaling rapidly to meet surging demand in the fast-growing personal genomics market.

If you’re excited to help redefine how the world thinks about health, join us in building the platform that brings every genome to life.

Solucionar problemas e direcionar operações com tecnologia e ciência de dados da maneira mais prática e objetiva visando aumentar os resultados dos nossos clientes e parceiros.

Comprometimento e transparência nas relações (B2B e B2C);

Bora somar e deixar os gráficos abaixo cada vez menos padronizados!

Nossa forma de trabalhar

Nossa forma de trabalhar é híbrida, mais para remota. Na Just, valorizamos o equilíbrio entre autonomia e alinhamento. Por isso, temos vagas remotas, híbridas e algumas que pedem presença em São Paulo, seja para encontros no escritório ou momentos conforme o escopo da vaga exigir. Se estiver em SP, conte com um espaço físico, moderno e bem equipado. Seja na sua casa ou na nossa, o que importa é se sentir bem no dia a dia!

WORK HERE MATTERS EVERYWHERE

Why Syneos Health

  • We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
  • We are committed to our Total Self culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Our Total Self culture is what unites us globally, and we are dedicated to taking care of our people.

Job Responsibilities

Sample management duties include receipt, inventory, chain of custody and storage, transfers and disposition of incurred samples, reference materials, matrixes, critical reagents and other items requiring defined storage conditions and tracking. Ensuring uncompromised integrity of materials and operating, troubleshooting and maintaining storage appliances and the environmental monitoring system are essential components of this role at all levels. The Sample Management Specialist II is skilled and thoroughly familiar with all routine and common duties of sample management and can perform any required actions independently and reliably. The Sample Management Specialist II will perform daily tasks and other duties as assigned.

Core Responsibilities

  • Responsible for receipt, control and disposition of study sample and reference materials.
  • Responsible for all aspects of shipping and receiving samples including destruction and transfer (as directed by client).
  • Provide samples and other materials to the laboratory staff for analysis as requested.
  • Keep an inventory of supplies used to manage samples and order supplies when needed.
  • Assist with the maintenance, operation and support of sample storage equipment and the associated monitoring system.
  • Archive documents associated with the management of study samples.

Qualifications

  • High School diploma.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, interpersonal skills, both written and spoken.
  • Good demonstrated computer skills (Microsoft Word, Excel and ability to employ sample-tracking software).
  • English level: Required bilingualism includes understanding simple messages and following basic instructions.

Note: We are always excited to connect with great talent. This posting is intended for a possible upcoming opportunity rather than a live role. By expressing your interest, you'll be added to our talent pipeline and considered should this role become available.

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 studies across 73,000 sites and 675,000+ trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment.

We translate unique clinical, medical affairs and commercial insights into outcomes to address modern market realities. We support a diverse, equitable and inclusive culture.

title: UI Artist (Project Based)
description:
About us

Amber, we're always on the hunt for the most talented individuals in the industry to join our team. We're dedicated to delivering top-notch service to our customers and know that our employees are key to making that happen. We offer attractive compensation packages and plenty of chances to grow with us, and we're always on the lookout for ways to do things better. Our team works together towards common goals and we value each member's contributions to our mission of continuous improvement and innovation.

About the role

Hello talented professionals! We're currently looking to expand our pool of talent and invite skilled individuals to join us by applying to this job posting. While specific positions may not be available immediately, we're proactively building a network of qualified candidates for future paid partnerships. If you're passionate about game development, eager to showcase and improve your skills on major titles, and open to potential partnerships down the line, we encourage you to apply and become part of our expert talent community. We look forward to connecting with you!

As a UI (User Interface) Artist, you will be responsible for creating visually appealing and intuitive user interfaces for mobile games and apps. You will collaborate closely with game designers, artists, and developers to design, implement, and optimize UI elements that enhance the overall gameplay experience and engage players.

The purpose of the role is to conceptualize, mock-up, and execute interface designs across many different systems, creating a visual and functional connection between the user experience and the game story. You will work with us to design and develop user interface styles, structures and flows integrated in our projects, augmenting gameplay systems and complementing the established art direction.

What you can expect

  • Profile Preselection: Our Talent Acquisition team will review your profile to ensure it aligns with our requirements and values.
  • Talent Acquisition Interview: Selected candidates will undergo an initial interview to discuss their experience, skills, and fit for the role.
  • Online Test: Qualified candidates will be invited to complete an online assessment to demonstrate their abilities.
  • Technical Interview: Finalists will participate in a technical interview to assess their proficiency and compatibility with our team when a project staffing plan is made.

We're committed to finding the best talent to join our growing team, and we look forward to connecting with you throughout this exciting process.

The Quest

  • UI Design: Create concept sketches, wireframes, and mockups for various UI screens, including menus, HUDs (Heads-Up Displays), overlays, and interactive elements. Develop cohesive visual themes and styles that align with the game's aesthetic and target audience.
  • Graphic Asset Creation: Design and produce high-quality UI assets, including icons, buttons, backgrounds, and visual effects. Use graphic design software to create scalable and visually appealing UI elements that enhance usability and accessibility.
  • Iconography and Typography: Select appropriate icons, symbols, and typography to convey information, enhance navigation, and communicate game mechanics effectively. Ensure consistency in iconography style, color schemes, and typography across all UI screens.
  • Animation and Motion Graphics: Implement animations and motion graphics to enhance interactivity, feedback, and visual interest within the UI. Create dynamic transitions, button animations, and visual effects that respond to player interactions and events.
  • User Experience (UX) Optimization: Conduct user research, playtesting, and usability testing to gather feedback and insights on UI design and functionality. Iterate on UI layouts, navigation flows, and interactive elements to improve user engagement, retention, and satisfaction.
  • Technical Implementation: Work closely with developers to integrate UI assets into the game engine (e.g., Unity, Unreal Engine) and ensure optimal performance across various mobile devices and screen resolutions. Collaborate on UI scripting and implementation tasks as needed.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with game designers, artists, programmers, and producers to align UI design goals with gameplay mechanics, narrative elements, and technical constraints. Participate in brainstorming sessions and provide creative input to enhance the overall game experience.
  • Quality Assurance: Conduct thorough testing and QA checks to ensure UI elements function as intended, adhere to design specifications, and meet performance targets. Identify and address any UI-related bugs, glitches, or usability issues in a timely manner.

The Skills

  • Strong understanding of design principles, color theory, typography, and composition. Ability to create visually appealing and cohesive UI designs that enhance usability and aesthetics.
  • Ability to bring static UI elements to life through dynamic animations and visual effects. Experience with animation software (e.g., After Effects, Spine) and a passion for creating engaging animations and motion graphics within UI.
  • User-Centered Design , knowledge of UX principles and methodologies, including user research, usability testing, and iterative design. Ability to empathize with users and advocate for their needs throughout the UI design process.
  • Best practices for designing UI interfaces for touchscreen devices. Experience with mobile game engines (e.g., Unity, Unreal Engine) is a plus. Familiarity with mobile gaming industry and platform-specific UI/UX guidelines.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to convey ideas, concepts, and feedback to cross-functional team members. Comfortable giving and receiving constructive criticism in a team-oriented environment.
  • Creative thinking and a passion for pushing the boundaries of UI design in mobile games. Ability to solve design challenges, iterate on ideas, and adapt to feedback and changing project requirements.

Software Expertise

  • Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, InDesign
  • Unity and Unreal engines
  • GitHub/SourceTree/Fork/Perforce
  • Miro/Confluence/Basecamp
  • Sketch, Adobe XD, Axure RP, Marvel, Affinity Designer, Balsamiq, Principle and Framer are a plus

Required Application Materials

  • Resume/CV
  • Cover letter
  • Reel or Portfolio demonstrating the art and technical skills

The Reward

  • Competitive project-based compensation
  • Opportunity to work on exciting and diverse projects
  • Clear communication and support throughout the project duration
  • Flexibility in project timelines and deadlines
  • Potential for long-term collaboration on future projects
  • Transparent and fair evaluation of your work

As a Senior Specialist, B2B Content Marketing, you will be responsible for the end-to-end content lifecycle: from ideation and creation to distribution and performance analysis. You’ll collaborate closely with stakeholders across departments to develop a wide range of content (e.g. articles, emails, case studies, videos, social media posts) that resonates with our B2B partners. The ideal candidate will be an excellent writer and strong communicator with strong project management and stakeholder engagement skills.

  • Vendor Management: Onboard and manage external vendors as required.

What You’ll Need To Succeed

  • Experience with content management systems, SEO, and website analytics tools (Google Analytics). Experience with CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, etc.) is a plus.
  • Experience working with design teams to produce visually engaging content.
  • Solid understanding of digital marketing and UX best practices.
  • Excellent project management, time management and multitasking abilities.
  • Strong communication skills and a confident, persuasive writing style (please be prepared to share your own writing samples).
  • Familiarity with the tech and travel industries, with experience in the online travel agency sector being a plus.

Why Join Us

At Agoda, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our communication strategies and driving growth within the B2B marketing division. If you are an innovative thinker passionate about travel technology and have the skills to elevate our brand narrative, we invite you to apply and be part of our dynamic team.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Agoda, we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds and orientations. We prioritize attracting diverse talent and cultivating an inclusive environment that encourages collaboration and innovation. Employment at Agoda is based solely on a person’s merit and qualifications. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity regardless of sex, age, race, color, national origin, religion, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, citizenship, veteran or military status, and other legally protected characteristics.

We will keep your application on file so that we can consider you for future vacancies and you can always ask to have your details removed from the file. For more details please read our privacy policy.

  • 2. Liderar um Squad Multidisciplinar

    • Criar e zelar pela manutenção e precisão das documentações de produto;
  • 3. Desenvolver e Operar Ferramentas de Comunicação
    • Liderar o desenvolvimento de ferramentas proprietárias para comunicação com clientes, com foco em eficiência, escalabilidade e personalização;

  • 6. Colaborar com Stakeholders Internos e Externos
    • Trabalhar em parceria com outras áreas (operações, atendimento, marketing, dados) para alinhar iniciativas e garantir uma visão integrada do cliente;

title: Senior product designer
description:
Sobre a Lemon

As mudanças climáticas são um desafio complexo, mas as soluções não podem ser. Enquanto as ações climáticas forem de difícil acesso, nunca teremos um impacto unificado grande o bastante para fazer a diferença no planeta. A Lemon é o jeito mais simples para empresas e pessoas impactarem positivamente o meio ambiente por meio de uma energia mais barata e limpa. Entregamos uma energia diferente da tradicional, por isso conseguimos oferecer uma conta de luz mais econômica e sustentável. Somos comprometidos com nossos clientes e com o planeta, por isso garantimos sempre um atendimento mais próximo e inovações que incentivam mudanças no setor elétrico. Somos apoiados pelos principais investidores em tecnologia de todo o mundo, incluindo fundos de venture capital como Kaszek, Lowercarbon Capital, Canary, Big Bets e Actyus. Endereçar um dos desafios mais significativos do mundo requer pensamento inovador e perspectivas diversas. Estamos construindo um time de pessoas com diferentes experiências, repertório profissional e formações educacionais. Se você compartilha da nossa paixão de criar essa a nova era da energia limpa, estamos ansiosos para conhecer o que de único você traz para Lemon.

Sobre a área de Design

Design na Lemon tem um papel estratégico para alcançar nossa missão. Como designer de produto, você terá protagonismo e voz para impactar a vida de milhares de pessoas com experiências simples e eficazes. Somos responsáveis por entender dores e necessidades dos clientes, levantar hipóteses, pesquisar, testar e projetar de ponta a ponta os produtos da Lemon. Atuamos lado a lado com Product Managers, Engenheiros e Data Analysts, em times colaborativos e orientados a resultados.

O que você vai fazer por aqui

Como Senior Product Designer, você será peça-chave na criação de soluções centradas no usuário que traduzem problemas complexos em experiências intuitivas e funcionais.

  • Liderar o trabalho de design em áreas de produto do discovery à entrega incluindo fluxos, wireframes, protótipos e design visual;
  • Colaborar com PMs, engenheiros, researchers e marketing para criar experiências que conectem tecnologia e pessoas;
  • Contribuir na definição da estratégia de design e atuar na execução em áreas críticas do produto;
  • Traduzir desafios complexos em soluções claras, utilizáveis e envolventes;
  • Trazer a perspectiva de design para discussões de planejamento, priorização e trade-offs de produto;
  • Conduzir ou apoiar pesquisas com usuários e aplicar os aprendizados nas decisões de design;
  • Evoluir e manter nosso design system, promovendo consistência e escalabilidade;
  • Compartilhar seu trabalho com frequência, usando documentação, protótipos e sessões de feedback;
  • Representar e defender a voz do usuário, equilibrando necessidades do negócio e limitações técnicas.

Perfil que buscamos

  • Se entusiasma com problemas difíceis técnicos, de produto ou de negócio;
  • Tem experiência e gosta de colaborar com times multidisciplinares;
  • Se comunica de forma clara e confortável com diferentes públicos;
  • Tem interesse por sustentabilidade, energia ou sistemas complexos;
  • Ya viveu experiências desafiadoras que fortalecem sua autonomia e confiança.

Experiência prévia / habilidades exigidas

  • 5+ anos de experiência em Product/UX Design, com portfólio digital relevante;
  • Histórico sólido em entregar experiências ponta a ponta em ambientes dinâmicos;
  • Excelência em design de interface e interação, com foco em soluções simples e funcionais;
  • Familiaridade com métodos de pesquisa e aplicação de insights no processo de design;
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura da informação, prototipação e usabilidade;
  • Capacidade de conduzir pesquisas qualitativas e quantitativas;
  • Boa compreensão de métricas, dados e KPIs de produto;
  • Conhecimento técnico suficiente para colaborar bem com desenvolvedores.

Temos diferentes frentes de atuação e, durante o processo, vamos buscar o melhor encaixe entre suas habilidades e os desafios da Lemon.

Experiência desejável

(não esperamos que você domine tudo valorizamos curiosidade e vontade de aprender)

  • Conhecimento em design comportamental e arquitetura da escolha;
  • Experiência na construção e evolução de Design Systems.

O que a gente oferece

  • Remuneração compatível com o mercado;
  • Trabalho remoto;
  • Materiais de escritório;
  • Coworking em todo o país;
  • Cartão Caju flexível (pode ser usado nas categorias alimentação, refeição, mobilidade, educação, saúde e cultura);
  • Plano de saúde;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Programa de saúde mental e bem-estar (Zenklub);
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Auxílio farmácia;
  • Lemon Feriados (dia de folga adicional próximo a feriados).

Leia aqui por favor

Pesquisas mostram que pessoas que se identificam como homens candidatam-se a um trabalho quando consideram que cumprem 60% dos requisitos, já pessoas que se identificam como mulheres e outros grupos minorizados tendem a aplicar apenas quando preenchem todos os requisitos possíveis. Então, se você acredita que possui habilidades para mudar o futuro da energia no país com a gente, mas não necessariamente preenche tudo listado acima, por favor prossiga na vaga. Adoraríamos bater um papo e descobrir se você é quem estamos procurando.

Diversidade & inclusão

Aqui na Lemon a diversidade é um compromisso ético e, por isso, estamos engajados para nos tornarmos uma empresa cada vez mais diversa e caso se sinta confortável, gostaríamos de saber na sua candidatura se auto identifica/declara pertencente a algum ou alguns grupos de diversidade. Encorajamos que se candidatem pessoas com as mais diferentes histórias e vivências, pois isso nos auxilia a criar um ambiente mais inclusivo.

title: Benefits Specialist
description:
Overview

Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.

Affirm is seeking a Benefits Specialist to play a crucial role in ensuring the smooth and accurate administration of our employee benefits programs, both domestically and internationally. You will be responsible for providing essential support to employees, maintaining data integrity, and assisting with various operational tasks to ensure compliance and efficiency.

What you\'ll do

  • Tier 1 Support & Issue Resolution: Serve as the primary point of contact for all Tier 1 benefit-related inquiries within Workday, covering US, EMEA, and Leave of Absence (LOA) questions.

  • Data Management & Maintenance: Monitor and resolve file feed errors on a daily/weekly basis to ensure data accuracy and integrity, with a focus on US and Canada. Calculate COBRA subsidies and enter all sick leave dates into Workday on a monthly basis. Assist with gathering required documentation for Leaves of Absence in EMEA regions.

  • Payroll & Leave Management: Manage questions and payroll processes related to leaves on a bi-weekly/semi-monthly basis. Administer Return to Health (RTH) program questions and leaves.

  • Administrative Support: Process day off requests via Workday tickets and accurately record in the designated tracker. Process and audit Benefits Enrolments with third-party vendors in applicable regions.

  • Project Support: Assist with updating benefits websites and internal drives. Assist with the implementation and ongoing maintenance of retirement file feeds with new vendors. Provide support for the onboarding and buildout of new benefit programs in EMEA regions.

What we look for

  • Experience: 6–12 months of relevant experience in HR operations, benefits administration, or a similar role. Familiarity with global benefits administration is a plus.

  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in Workday required. Strong understanding of HRIS systems and data management. Proficient in Google Suite (Sheets, Drive), as well as Excel.

  • Soft Skills: Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to clearly explain complex information. Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues. Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

  • Education: Bachelor\'s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field preferred, or equivalent practical experiences.

Base Pay Grade - E

Equity Grade - 2

Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills. Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents).

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $80,000 - $100,000

USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $71,000 - $91,000

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range.

Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

#LI-Remote

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company! The majority of our roles are remote and you can work almost anywhere within the country of employment. Affirmers in proximal roles have the flexibility to work remotely, but will occasionally be required to work out of their assigned Affirm office. A limited number of roles remain office-based due to the nature of their job responsibilities.

We’re extremely proud to offer competitive benefits that are anchored to our core value of people come first. Some key highlights of our benefits package include:

  • Health care coverage - Affirm covers all premiums for all levels of coverage for you and your dependents
  • Flexible Spending Wallets - generous stipends for spending on Technology, Food, various Lifestyle needs, and family forming expenses
  • Time off - competitive vacation and holiday schedules allowing you to take time off to rest and recharge
  • ESPP - An employee stock purchase plan enabling you to buy shares of Affirm at a discount

About Nucleus Global

Nucleus Global is a global leader in the medical communications space with locations across Europe, US, and APAC and a portfolio of 90-plus clients. It forms part of the Inizio Medical group, which includes Ashfield MedComms, ApotheCom, and MEDiSTRAVA. Its unique position as part of this international network gives it a key advantage over its commercial competitors in terms of the scale of its reach and depth of its expertise.

About the role

We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced Account Manager to join the group working on medical affairs accounts. This role would suit someone who enjoys the challenge of acquiring scientific knowledge and expertise across different therapy areas, and developing excellent relationships with clients.

Here\'s what you\'ll be doing:

As an Account Manager, your role will be varied and could include scientific and strategic consultation and management of professional relations with leading academics and development of a range of medical affairs and disease state education projects. Using your strong project management skills and scientific expertise, you will help lead a team to deliver a range of services to clients. You will work within assigned account(s) to manage and ensure that all projects and services are delivered based on the clients business needs including overseeing all projects, deadlines, budgets, and team assignments. Support existing client business development as well as potential new business to achieve agreed-upon financial targets.

About you

To succeed, you must have a Bachelor’s degree, preferably in life sciences (advanced degree, preferred). 3+ years experience working in a medical communications agency or ad agency working on medical affairs projects is required. You will also need to demonstrate solid project management skills including financial budgeting skills. A strong ability to work well within a team along with exceptional client relations and communication skills is a must. Working knowledge or previous experience utilizing Veeva, a plus.

Benefits

  • Health coverage
  • Retirement
  • PTO

In addition to a great benefits package, we are happy to talk flexible working. We are also known for our friendly and informal working environment with Friday socials across our offices, regular wellbeing weeks, and Town Hall events. We offer excellent opportunities for career and personal development, including opportunities to transfer your skills to our other offices around the world.

Our Pledge

At Nucleus Global, we are committed to encouraging a culture of diversity, inclusion and belonging where everyone can bring each facet of themselves to work each day. We believe that strength in diversity and inclusivity is a driver of our success.

Nucleus Global is not accepting unsolicited résumés from search firms for this employment opportunity. Regardless of past practice, all résumés submitted by search firms to any employee of Nucleus Global and its affiliated companies by email, the Internet or in any form — without a current signed fee agreement for that position (as authorised by the Recruitment Manager) — will be deemed the sole property of Nucleus Global, and no fee will be paid in the event you are hired as a result of the referral or through other means.

Nucleus Global is part of Inizio Medical. Inizio is a strategic partner for health and life sciences with a full suite of medical, marketing, advisory and engagement services.

The base salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position. This range may differ based on your experience and skill set, geographic location, and cost of living considerations. We consider compensation more than just a base salary – that’s why we also offer an exceptional range of flexible benefits, personal support and tailored learning and development opportunities all designed to help you realize your full potential both in life and at work. Compensation $70,000 — $94,000 USD

Don\'t meet every job requirement? That\'s okay! Our company is dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you\'re excited about this role, but your experience doesn\'t perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.

\Experiência como Scrum Master;

\Domínio sobre princípios fundamentais do Kanban;

\Conhecimento profundo sobre princípios e processo Scrum;

\Experiência com processo e gestão de times;

\Medir e reportar métricas de produtividade, qualidade e eficácia dos projetos;

\Analisar e gerenciar riscos;

A MJV é mais do que uma simples consultoria de tecnologia e inovação . Somos um grupo de mentes diversas, visionárias e determinadas, combinando design, dados e uma mentalidade ágil para oferecer soluções completas, que vão desde a concepção até a implementação de TI.

A transformação digital também é um dos nossos pilares. Isso mesmo, o Hub de Tecnologia da Ambev!

description:
Job description

Já pensou em somar no CSC de um dos maiores grupos empresariais do Brasil?

Você soma com nosso crescimento!

Aqui você é o protagonista da transformação que queremos. A sua paixão, senso de dono, responsabilidade e inconformismo são os combustíveis para chegarmos mais longe.

Sobre a área

Estamos em busca de uma(o) Analista de Infraestrutura Sênior para atuar em nosso Centro de Soluções Compartilhadas (CSC), que presta serviços estratégicos para diversas unidades de negócio do grupo.

Main responsibilities

No seu dia a dia você focará em:

  • Gerenciar e manter a infraestrutura de redes corporativas (LAN, WAN, WLAN), garantindo alta disponibilidade, desempenho e segurança.
  • Configurar, monitorar e otimizar equipamentos de rede : switches, roteadores, firewalls, balanceadores de carga.
  • Implementar políticas de segurança de rede : segmentação, ACLs, VPNs, IDS/IPS.
  • Monitorar tráfego e desempenho utilizando ferramentas como Zabbix, Nagios, SolarWinds ou similares.
  • Atuar na resolução de incidentes críticos e problemas complexos , garantindo a continuidade dos serviços.
  • Planejar e executar projetos de expansão e atualização tecnológica (ex.: SD-WAN, redes definidas por software).
  • Gerenciar endereçamento IP, VLANs e QoS para garantir qualidade de serviços críticos.
  • Documentar topologias, procedimentos e mudanças para compliance e auditoria.
  • Colaborar com equipes de segurança, servidores e telecom para integração de soluções.

Requirements and skills

Para esta posição procuramos talentos que tenham:

  • Experiência avançada em redes corporativas : protocolos TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, VLAN, STP.
  • Domínio em configuração e troubleshooting de equipamentos Cisco, Aruba ou equivalentes.
  • Conhecimento em firewalls e segurança de rede : Fortinet, Palo Alto, Check Point.
  • Experiência com redes sem fio corporativas : Wi-Fi 6, controladoras, políticas de acesso.
  • Familiaridade com SD-WAN e redes definidas por software .
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e análise de tráfego (Wireshark, NetFlow).
  • Conhecimento em ambientes híbridos e integração com nuvem (AWS, Azure, VPNs site-to-site).
  • Habilidade em gestão de mudanças e projetos seguindo boas práticas (ITIL, PMI).

Você pode se destacar se:

  • Certificações: CCNP/CCIE (Cisco), NSE (Fortinet).
  • Experiência em ambientes de CSC ou empresas com estrutura de TI compartilhada;
  • Conhecimento em práticas de ITIL e gestão de serviços.
  • Conhecimento e experiência de atuação em ambientes SOX

Additional information

Oferecemos uma proposta de remuneração fixa e variável competitiva, além de uma série de benefícios, veja alguns deles:

title: Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Practice Lead
description:
Overview

LeapPoint, an OPMG Company, is a digital advisory firm focused on helping organizations connect their people, processes, and technology to improve orchestration across the entire marketing lifecycle. As an Adobe Gold Solution Partner, LeapPoint’s expertise spans the entire Adobe Experience Cloud ecosystem. The company’s certified consultants have delivered more than 600,000 hours of Adobe-related implementations and integrations and actively support hundreds of enterprise-level clients. LeapPoint is part of Omnicom’s precision marketing division, Omnicom Precision Marketing Group (OPMG). OPMG is a global network of agencies and consultancies spanning CRM, customer experience design, and marketing technology and business consulting. LeapPoint is seeking an AEM Practice Lead to deliver on our vision of Connected Work, where we help clients understand, design, and build a connected ecosystem of platforms that drive hyper-personalization, data-driven decisions, and successful outcomes. In this role, you will lead a team of AEM Architects and Developers, oversee the delivery of high-impact Adobe Content Supply Chain Solution implementations, and serve as a trusted advisor to our clients. You will drive technical excellence, shape practice strategy, and ensure alignment with Adobe’s MarTech ecosystem, fostering growth for both our clients and our company.

Responsibilities

  • Practice Leadership: define and execute the strategic vision for the AEM Services practice, including service offerings, delivery methodologies, and team development.
  • Project Oversight: lead end-to-end delivery of AEM Solutions, ensuring quality, timeliness, and alignment with client goals; manage scope, risks, and resources effectively.
  • Client Engagement: act as a senior consultant and subject matter expert, advising clients on AEM best practices, digital transformation strategies, and integration with Adobe Experience Cloud (e.g., Analytics, Target, Campaign).
  • Team Management: mentor and grow a high-performing team of AEM professionals, fostering technical expertise, collaboration, and career development.
  • Solution Design: architect scalable, robust AEM solutions that are integrated with the Content Supply Chain and tailored to client needs, including features such as multi-site and multi-channel delivery, personalization/ targeting, content aggregation & syndication, multi-lingual support, automated workflow management, social media, etc.
  • Business Development: collaborate with sales and marketing teams to identify opportunities, craft proposals, and pitch AEM solutions to prospective clients.
  • Innovation & Standards: stay ahead of AEM and Adobe MarTech trends, driving adoption of new features (e.g., AEM as a Cloud Service, Edge Delivery Services) and establishing reusable frameworks or accelerators.
  • Partnerships: strengthen relationships with Adobe and other technology partners to enhance our practice capabilities and certifications.

Qualifications & Skills

The following skills will set you up for success:

Experience:

  • 8+ years of experience in Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) solution design and implementation with a deep understanding of what is possible within the system.
  • 3+ years in a leadership or practice lead role within a consulting or professional services environment.
  • Proven track record of delivering complex AEM projects for enterprise clients in Adobe 6.5 or higher and AEMaaCS.
  • AEM Edge Delivery Services (EDS).

Technical Skills:

  • Understanding of object-oriented design principles.
  • Familiarity in design and development of enterprise systems as part of a complete software product lifecycle.
  • Deep expertise in AEM Sites, Assets, Forms, and integrations with Adobe Experience Cloud tools.
  • Proficiency in Java, OSGi, Sling, HTL, and modern front-end frameworks (e.g., React, Angular).
  • Experience working with or configuring Workfront is preferred.

Soft Skills:

  • Exceptional leadership and team-building abilities.
  • Strong client-facing communication and presentation skills.
  • Strategic thinker with a problem-solving mindset and business acumen.

Education & Certifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field preferred.
  • Adobe Certified Expert or Master in AEM (Architect, Developer, or Business Practitioner) highly desirable.

Travel: This position may require approximately 10-20% travel.

Compensation & Benefits

  • The base salary for this role is $190,000 - $225,000. Compensation varies based on experience, qualifications, and demonstrated results as an AEM Practice Lead.
  • Benefits include bonus, comprehensive healthcare, PTO, and more.

About LeapPoint

LeapPoint, an OPMG Company, has been on the Forbes list of America\'s Best Management Consulting Firms for eight consecutive years as well as being an honored Vault Consulting Top 50 firm, named a top boutique consulting firm, top consulting firm for culture, and top consulting firm for diversity. We were just named the 2025 Adobe Digital Experience GenStudio Partner of the Year – Americas and the 2025 Adobe Digital Experience Partner of the Year – UK&I.

This only happened because of the incredible people that decided to make LeapPoint their home. We work hard, we support each other, we look for opportunities to learn and grow, and we put our customers at the center of everything we do…some firms say it, we actually do it.

This maniacal focus on helping customers deliver outcomes that propel business forward led us to the creation of a framework that now has a long history of connecting people, processes, and systems. We call it Connected Work and it’s how we deliver powerful experiences for customers and employees. We believe in it so much we created the first ever Connected Work Officer executive role.

As you can imagine, we move fast, we wear lots of hats, and we stand behind each other so that when someone falls a teammate is there to catch them. Make no mistake, this makes for a unique environment, which means we are looking for unique people.

We put our people first, we invest in giving them the tools they need to be successful here and beyond, and we want them to be healthy, happy, and fulfilled while doing work that matters.

If this excites you, let's have a quick chat to get to know one another and discuss your future.

EEO Statement

Leapoint, LLC provides equal employment opportunity to all individuals regardless of their race, color, creed, religion, gender, age, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by state, federal, or local law. Discrimination of any type will not be tolerated.

description:
Working At Bitso

We are a diverse team that takes pride in understanding the perspectives of others. We fully embrace working remotely and we are eager to act, improve and accelerate progress inside and outside of our organization.

To drive revolutionary changes in society and make crypto useful, we delight our customers with world-class products, deep care, and intentional empathy.

Your Purpose

The Accounts Payable Specialist, who will be part of the Finance division, will be responsible for the administration and recording of expenses (overhead, employee expenses, reimbursements, and credit card reconciliation) as well as the administration of supplier master data.

Reports To

Accounts Payable Lead

Who You Are

  • At least 3 years of experience in accounts payable in Brazil.
  • Proven expertise in processing and performing the accounting registration for local payment methods, including Boleto Bancário and PIX.
  • Experience with other Latin American countries is a plus.
  • Solid understanding of Brazilian tax requirements applicable to bill payments, including knowledge of withholding taxes (e.g., IRRF, PIS/COFINS, ISS).
  • Experience with NetSuite and/or other ERP systems.
  • Degree in Accounting, Business Management, or a related field.
  • Strong aptitude for numbers and computations.
  • High attention to detail and accuracy is a must.
  • Organized and proactive, with the ability to take initiative and prioritize tasks effectively.
  • An agile and efficient work ethic with the ability to work independently and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication skills, in both verbal and written form (English).
  • A strong sense of responsibility and commitment to the company's core values.
  • Service-oriented attitude.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive financial information.

What You Will Do

  • Ensure all accounts payable policies and procedures are adhered to including travel and related expenses, mainly in Brazil and Latin American entities.
  • Improve and continue accounts payable policies.
  • Maintain accounts payable files.
  • Review of tax requirements.
  • Weekly payments schedule.
  • Prepares journal entries; maintains and reconciles ledger accounts.
  • Ensure all reporting is completed accurately and timely, including month-end closing, audits, and other requests.
  • Maintaining constant and strong communication with the treasury and planning teams to ensure the veracity of accounting and financial information.
  • Working hand in hand with the company’s Treasurer to report weekly and monthly the expenses detailed by the cost center and tribes.
  • Reconciliation and integration of accounts payable balances (by name and age).
  • Credit card reconciliation (by name and age).
  • Assist with audits by providing supporting records and documentation.

Who We Are

With over 9 million users, Bitso is the leading cryptocurrency platform in Latin America. We are developing the cryptocurrency ecosystem in the region and enabling financial inclusion. We believe crypto is the future of finance, and we’re committed to making it useful by providing equal access to safe and intuitive financial products.

When we hire people for our team, we specifically test for the following traits in addition to our cultural values:

  • High Sense of Urgency : We prioritize candidates who demonstrate a high sense of urgency and responsibility.
  • Exceptional Hard Skills : We seek individuals who possess exceptional skills in their respective fields, with no room for mediocrity.
  • Self-Management : We look for individuals who can independently manage their work, career, and professional development.

Overview

Em 2017, a Companhia realizou seu primeiro investimento ao adquirir o Vera Cruz Hospital, localizado na cidade Campinas-SP, que com mais de 80 anos de atuação, é um dos mais tradicionais hospitais da cidade. O hospital atualmente conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 08 leitos de Apoio Cirúrgico, 110 leitos de internação, 14 leitos de UTI Adulto, 10 leitos de Unidade Cardiológica, 10 leitos Semi-intensiva, 16 leitos Maternidade/Alojamento Conjunto, 09 leitos Pediatria e Pronto Socorro 24h. Além de atender mais de 66 especialidades, ter acreditação ONA 3 e ter conquistado em 2025 a acreditação da JCI.

Desde então, por meio do Vera Cruz Hospital, aumentamos nossa rede de forma substancial em Campinas e região. Com a inauguração, por exemplo, de serviços novos como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia, a Unidade de Atenção Primária da Saúde e a criação das unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba.

Nesse mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos também a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2Care.

A regional faz parte do grupo Hospital Care que em 2017, a união das pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar do Brasil, possibilitou o início da trajetória da companhia. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde que propõe um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, tendo como objetivo promover o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Para isso, conta com um sistema de saúde completo com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos.

Como estratégia de atuação, está presente em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais para a gestão de saúde, dentro de três estados, São Paulo, Paraná e Florianópolis. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos tornar a melhor Rede de Prestadores de Saúde Privada do Brasil.

title: Channel Account Manager - Resellers
description:
Job Description

Join the team redefining how the world experiences design. This role is fully remote and can be based anywhere; Canva’s headquarters are in Sydney, Australia, and the team spans the globe.

Where And How You Can Work

Our headquarters is in Sydney, Australia, but our team spans the globe. Since we don’t have a physical campus in Brazil, this role is fully remote — giving you the flexibility to do your best work from wherever you thrive.

What You’d Be Doing In This Role

As Canva scales, change continues to be part of our DNA. This will give you the flavour of the type of things you’ll be working on when you start, but it will likely evolve.

At the moment, this role is focused on:

  • Leading reseller relationships across Latin America — onboarding, enabling, and growing performance with key partners.
  • Designing and delivering training, tools, and co-branded campaigns to help partners effectively promote Canva’s offerings.
  • Driving channel sales growth through business planning, performance tracking, and joint sales initiatives.
  • Representing Canva externally — supporting partners and stepping in with customers when needed.
  • Championing the voice of our resellers internally to ensure they have the support and resources to succeed.

You\'re Probably A Match If You Have

  • Extensive experience across channel management, partnership development, or business development, with a focus on large resellers or channel sales.
  • A proven track record of managing and developing successful reseller programs or indirect sales channels.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills, with the ability to influence both internal and external stakeholders.
  • Analytical skills, with the ability to leverage data to make informed decisions and drive performance improvements.
  • Experience working with CRM systems (Salesforce) and other partner management platforms is preferred.
  • Experience working with large resellers in Latin America, with a good contact network.
  • Direct customer sales experience desirable, but not mandatory.
  • Must be fluent in English and Portuguese; Spanish is advantageous.

About The Team

The Partnerships team sits within our Sales & Success Supergroup and plays a pivotal role in expanding Canva’s reach and impact through strategic, scalable relationships. We partner with leading technology platforms, agencies, and ecosystem players to unlock new growth channels and embed Canva into the workflows of teams and organizations around the world. Our team thrives at the intersection of creativity and commerce—bringing commercial rigour, go-to-market creativity, and deep collaboration to every partnership.

What\'s In It For You?

Achieving our big goals motivates us to work hard — and we do — but you\'ll experience moments of magic, connectivity, and fun woven throughout life at Canva. We offer a range of benefits to set you up for success in and outside of work.

  • Equity packages — we want our success to be yours too
  • Inclusive parental leave policy
  • An annual Vibe & Thrive package to support your wellbeing, social connection, office setup & more
  • Flexible leave options to recharge and support you personally

Check out lifeatcanva.com for more info.

Other Stuff To Know

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process. We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva, so even if you don’t feel your skills match what’s listed above — we still want to hear from you. Interviews are conducted virtually.

title: Global Energy Manager
description:
Overview

JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way. Our people at JLL and JLL Technologies are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

At JLL, we are driving sustainability through everything that we do, across all service lines and job positions. Specifically, we are growing our Sustainability practice to drive end-to-end sustainability solutions in real estate, from site selection to decommissioning.

In this role, you will work directly with one of our clients, implementing the sustainability program across the relevant target sites globally. The role will report into JLL’s Sustainability Operations Global Director in a matrixed organization. Key responsibilities include implementation, optimization and management of a targeted energy management program that delivers measurable savings, carbon reduction, and utilities cost management.

This position is a fully remote position. Being located near a client hub site of Austin, Kansas City, Nashville, Burlington, MA, is a plus but not required.

What this job involves

Key responsibilities include:

  • Develop and execute site level energy management strategies for highest impact target sites worldwide.
  • Design and implement sustainability programs targeting measurable savings, carbon reduction, and cost optimization.
  • Identify and prioritize cost-effective energy optimization opportunities that align with existing capital and operational budget frameworks.
  • Partner closely with regional site teams and facility managers to implement energy programs and reach sustainability objectives.
  • Conduct remote or site assessments to identify sustainability conservation opportunities and operational improvement.
  • Drive operational improvements through systematic identification and implementation of energy performance enhancement opportunities and ECMs.
  • Engage with JLL facility managers to become the key point of contact for the provision of advice related to all aspects of environmental sustainability.
  • Support corporate sustainability reporting objectives and provide management information relating to utilities use and environmental impact.
  • Leverage energy, waste, and water data collection processes within JLL’s and client technology platforms and produce monthly and quarterly reports tailored to clients’ requirements.
  • Drive continuous improvements through data analysis and benchmarking.
  • Provide actionable management insights on utility usage patterns.
  • Collaborate with other JLL energy managers globally to share best practices, develop case studies and develop new business opportunities.
  • Develop and optimize systems and processes to deliver industry-leading sustainability performance, utilizing utility and sustainability management platforms for monitoring and reporting.
  • Support cross-functional teams in delivering sustainability projects to meet portfolio-wide sustainability goals.

Every day is different, and in all these activities, we’d encourage you to show your ingenuity.

Requirements – Essential

  • 5+ years energy management experience.
  • Certified Energy Manager (CEM) Certification.
  • University Degree (Science, engineering, math or related fields).
  • Technical understanding of HVAC, electrical, mechanical, and building automation systems.
  • Proficiency in conducting on-site and desktop assessments to identify water, waste, energy and carbon savings opportunities (e.g. ASHRAE Level 3).
  • In-depth understanding of energy and water conservation measures in the built environment.
  • Experience with benchmarking and analyzing utility data to drive sustainability measures.
  • Experience supporting and managing project delivery by providing technical services guidance and direction to achieve and monitor energy and sustainability project goals.
  • Develop supplier relationships to manage the delivery of environmental and sustainability projects and report on progress made.
  • Proven ability to work effectively with remote teams and implement projects through local partnerships.
  • In-depth understanding of Greenhouse Gas Emission scopes and reporting.
  • Ability to explain complex technical or sensitive information and build consensus across diverse stakeholders.

Requirements – Desirable

  • Experience conducting site walkthroughs to identify conservation measures (e.g. ASHRAE Level 1 and 2).
  • Strong project management skills and ability to prioritize and meet deadlines in a high-pressure, globally-distributed environment.
  • Experience in preparing tenders and work orders and the ability to select appropriate equipment and service vendors.
  • Knowledge of environmental reporting, utility management and energy budgets, an environmental improvement program, and ISO 14001 compliance.
  • Familiarity with energy procurement processes and renewable energy options.
  • Ability to write recommendation reports for varying audiences (technical and non-technical).
  • Evidence of delivering innovation and engaging positively with continuous change and improvement.
  • Cross-cultural communication skills and international team experience.
  • Experience optimizing energy performance within existing budget constraints.

  • Drive Change - Thrives on change, learning agility, intellectually curious, appetite for risks, digital drive.

  • Business first - Focuses on customers and clients, business/financial acumen, JLL first.
